data.name: Hallamah
data.gender_notes: Hallamah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root h-l-m, meaning 'to be generous, to be gracious, to be beautiful.' This name signifies a gentle, kind, and beautiful soul. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) had a companion named Hallamah, known for her graciousness and generosity. The name Hallamah carries the meaning “Gracious, beautiful, gentle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hallamah usually hope their child will grow to embody gracious, beautiful, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Hallamah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gracious, beautiful, gentle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hallamah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
